Spain general election, November 29, 2026

Forecast for the 350-seat Congress of Deputies. A government needs 176 votes to win an investiture on the first ballot, or more yes than no votes on the second.

Updated Nov 14, 2026. The forecast updates every day until November 23. After that, Spanish law bars publishing new polls before the November 29 vote, and the last forecast stays up.
94%
chance PP and Vox together win 176 seats or more
4%
chance the parties that backed Sánchez in 2023 win 176 or more
83%
chance the PP wins the most seats

Average seats in our simulations

Each simulation draws a national result from the polls, spreads it across the 52 constituencies, and allocates seats with the D'Hondt method. Parties run from left to right.
